pages.text: Bitter mate: Tranquility. Nearby hostile mobs get slowed.$(br2)Sweet mate: Out of my way! Lots of speed, you push nearby mobs and you are slow for a moment afterwards.
Milk mate: Development. Nearby babies grow up instantly.$(br2)Yuyos mate: Prosperity. Extra luck, some experience now and then and 50 % more experience from kills.
